intro.heading: Building, learning, and leaving notes along the way.
intro.description: I’m Chris, currently CTO at Smart.pr. These are my notes, ideas, and things I’ve learned along the way.

items.heading: Building

items.heading: Thinking in systems
items.description: I like getting to the root of a problem, keeping the long view in mind, and making practical choices along the way.

items.heading: Staying curious
items.description: The web is a great place to play, experiment, learn quickly, and see what happens when you make things.
